description: Export marker report for current day to filename s . If s is not given, a default file name of \(markers_Day000.txt\) where 000 is replaced by the current day.
notes: Default filenames are massflow_Day<N>.txt / massflow_Day<N>.vtk, where N is the current flow day. The manual's stated default (markers_Day000) is wrong.
The filename must be a quoted string and is written verbatim - no extension is appended ('report-export vtk 'probe3'' wrote the file probe3).
The format keyword must come BEFORE the filename: after a filename it is reported as an unused extra parameter and the text report is written anyway.
An unquoted token is not taken as a filename (unused extra parameter; the default-name report is still written).
File format: see reference topic 'file-formats marker-report'.
The format keywords are new with 9.8; the 9.7-era page had none.

keywords.name: text
keywords.description: Write the text (.txt) marker report. The default when no format keyword is given.

keywords.name: vtk
keywords.description: Write the VTK (.vtk) marker report (needs a VTK-aware viewer).

keywords.name: both
keywords.description: Write both the .txt and the .vtk report for the same day.

verification: Live-verified 2026-11-10 on MassFlow 9.8.54 (GUI bridge) (state grade): text -> 'Marker report saved to file massflow_Day0.txt'; vtk -> 'VTK marker report saved to massflow_Day0.vtk'; both -> both lines; quoted filename written verbatim before and after a format keyword.
